english.title: Use / cause / permit use of transport equipment without designated mark for international carriage of perishable foods
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[caused]_
(C)_[permitted use of]_

transport equipment for the international carriage of perishable foodstuffs, without exhibiting the designated mark for that equipment
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7(1)(b) and (2) of the International Carriage of Perishable Foodstuffs Act 1976.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without reasonable excuseused / caused / permitted use of
transport equipment for perishable foodstuffs
without exhibiting designated mark for that equipment

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) A defence exists for this offence under section 7(3) if the person charged can prove they are the carrier for hire or reward of the perishable foodstuffs to which the charge relates and it is a term of the contract for the carriage that he does not undertake to comply or to secure compliance with the requirements of the regulation to which the charge relates. (ii) For corporate liability see section 13 of the Act.
